episodes.synopsis: 20 years after it's win over the Aposdoll invaders, the giant robot, Dandivine, seems like a fading memory...
episodes.title: An Old-Fashioned Guardian

episodes.synopsis: As he worries about his relationship, Gekiha finds himself in Dandivine's cockpit with the Aposdolls' return.
episodes.title: An Ace, but Only Because of His Face

episodes.synopsis: Gekiha is officially Dandivine's new pilot, but will his new duties allow him to attend to his love life?
episodes.title: Outcome of a Confession

episodes.synopsis: A new transfer student named Suruga arrives at Gekiha's school and makes a huge impact.
episodes.title: The Golden Transfer Student

episodes.synopsis: Gekiha and Suruga each ponder the identity of their rival robot's pilot, blind to the truth.
episodes.title: With Friends Like These...

episodes.synopsis: Gekiha is injured and bedridden, leaving Dandivine without a pilot.
episodes.title: Ballad of the Slippers

episodes.synopsis: Gekiha has lost both Akane and Dandivine to Suruga. But will he give them up without a fight?
episodes.title: What Defines a Protagonist
